title: Explaining the Roles of Experts in Mixture-of-Experts LLMs for Personalization
abstract: arXiv:2610.22127v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Personalization of Large Language Models (LLMs) is increasingly important for user-centric applications, yet prior methods mainly adapt dense LLMs, whose polysemantic neurons, each encoding multiple unrelated concepts, hinder localizing the components behind personalization, and thus understanding and controlling it. We propose to personalize Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLMs, which sparsely route each token to a few specialized experts, reducing polysemanticity and enabling such localization. We adapt three open-weight MoE LLMs on a large-scale personalization dataset and train crosscoders on paired activations of the personalized and non-personalized models to learn interpretable personalized latents, from which we identify the experts encoding distinct personalization features. The personalized MoE LLMs perform competitively with dense LLMs while activating only a fraction of their parameters, exhibit lower polysemanticity than dense LL

translated_title: 解释混合专家大语言模型中专家在个性化中的作用
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的个性化对以用户为中心的应用日益重要，然而先前的方法主要对稠密LLM进行适配，这类模型的多义神经元（每个神经元编码多个不相关的概念）阻碍了对个性化背后组件的定位，从而也阻碍了对个性化的理解和控制。我们提出对混合专家（MoE）LLM进行个性化，这类模型将每个token稀疏地路由到少数几个专门的专家，降低了多义性并使这种定位成为可能。我们在一个大规模个性化数据集上适配了三个开源权重的MoE LLM，并在个性化模型与非个性化模型的成对激活上训练交叉编码器，以学习可解释的个性化潜在表示，从中识别出编码不同个性化特征的专家。经过个性化的MoE LLM在与稠密LLM性能相当的情况下仅激活其一小部分参数，并表现出比稠密LLM更低的多义性。
tldr: 提出利用混合专家架构的稀疏路由降低神经元多义性，通过交叉编码器定位并解释大语言模型个性化背后的专家角色，在性能相当的情况下仅激活少量参数。
en_tdlr: Proposing to personalize MoE LLMs, whose sparse expert routing reduces polysemanticity, enabling the identification and explanation of experts underlying personalization with competitive performance while activating only a fraction of parameters.
